label_question: At the anchored call, does the callee resolve to %eval% (direct or indirect) under the assumptions?
assumptions: Classic sloppy-mode script (strict code and ES modules reject an `eval` binding).
Standard globals are not replaced before the call (globalThis.eval, window.eval are %eval%).
`window` cases assume a browser script; Node has no `window`.

label_values.negative: The call does not evaluate code through %eval%.
label_values.undetermined: The value cannot be decided from this file alone.

sites.label: negative
sites.rationale: Local const holds JSON.parse; no code evaluation.

sites.rationale: Local let holds JSON.parse.
